cost: Sum O(k_b+k_g+n*k_d+n^2*k_c) arithmetic plus callback costs; serial auxiliary O(n), input matrix O(n^2). Hard dimension and iteration limits remain leaf-specific.
description: Bracket roots and deterministic strictly unimodal minima; descend diagonal quadratics and solve dense symmetric positive definite linear systems with explicit stopping observations.
forward: Bracket roots and deterministic strictly unimodal minima; descend diagonal quadratics and solve dense symmetric positive definite linear systems with explicit stopping observations.

On q(x)=d*x^2/2-b*x with d>0, derivative root, scalar minimizer, diagonal descent and one-dimensional CG share b/d. For a common diagonal system, GD and CG target identical stationarity but need not share iteration counts or statuses.
inverse: Exclude input/report pairs outside each tagged solver relation: exhausted or stagnant reports relabeled as convergence, bracket-width bounds promoted to objective bounds, residual norms promoted to unconditional coordinate error, or visited positive curvature promoted to global SPD.

A returned estimate and status admit many callbacks, brackets, initial states and budgets. For zero residual x, any positive diagonal D with b=D*x is compatible. Common roots/minima survive positive scaling; output does not uniquely recover the problem.
limitations: Continuity, deterministic strict unimodality and global SPD are not established by sampling or visited curvature. Residual magnitude alone does not bound coordinate error without conditioning. Floating-point underflow and conservative arithmetic rejection remain possible.
Finite tests and source-derived models are not a universal proof.
state: Preserve finite reports, bracket order, dimensional agreement and distinct converged, exhausted and stagnated states. True residual is recomputed for stopping.
